title: An Analysis of Programming Course Evaluations Before and After the Introduction of an Autograder
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not contain a benchmark that measures anything related to faith or religion. The analysis focuses on student satisfaction and perception of programming courses.
findings: This paper does not analyze any aspects of religion or faith; therefore, there are no findings related to religion.
